## Convert Video

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Convert videos between containers and codecs (MP4/H.264, H.265, WebM/VP9, AV1, MKV, MOV, AVI, GIF) with quality control and optional GPU encoding.

```sh
dogubako video convert <files…> [options]
```

Id `video.convert` · MCP `video_convert` · Output: files · Timeout 240 min

Also found by: transcode, mp4, webm, mkv, mov, avi, h264, h265, hevc, vp9, av1, prores, format

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Videos. Accepts video/\*, .mkv .mp4 .mov .webm .avi .m4v +10 more. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `mp4` | One of: `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv` (MKV (Matroska)), `mov` (MOV (QuickTime)), `avi`, `gif` (Animated GIF). |
| `video_codec` | `--video-codec` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto` (Auto (best for container)), `h264` (H.264 / AVC), `h265` (H.265 / HEVC), `vp9`, `av1`, `vp8`, `mpeg4` (MPEG-4 Part 2), `prores` (Apple ProRes), `copy` (Copy (no re-encode)). Only used when `format` is one of `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, `mov`, `avi`. |
| `audio_codec` | `--audio-codec` | choice | `auto` | One of: `auto`, `aac`, `mp3`, `opus`, `vorbis`, `flac`, `pcm` (PCM (uncompressed)), `ac3` (AC-3), `copy`, `none` (Remove audio). Only used when `format` is one of `mp4`, `webm`, `mkv`, `mov`, `avi`. |
| `quality` | `--quality` | choice | `medium` | One of: `high`, `medium` (Balanced), `low` (Small file), `custom` (Custom CRF). |
| `crf` | `--crf` | integer 0–63 | `23` | Codec-native constant quality value (lower = better). Only used when `quality` is `custom`. *Advanced.* |
| `speed` | `--speed` | choice | `medium` | One of: `fast`, `medium`, `slow` (Slow (smaller)). *Advanced.* |
| `audio_bitrate` | `--audio-bitrate` | integer 32–512 | `160` | Audio bitrate (kbit/s). *Advanced.* |
| `hardware` | `--hardware` | choice | `none` | Use a hardware encoder when present (falls back to software). One of: `none` (Software only), `auto` (Auto (use GPU if available)), `nvenc` (NVIDIA NVENC), `qsv` (Intel Quick Sync), `vaapi` (VA-API), `videotoolbox` (Apple VideoToolbox), `amf` (AMD AMF). *Advanced.* |

## Compress Video

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Shrink videos by quality level or to a target file size (two-pass bitrate), optionally capping the resolution.

```sh
dogubako video compress <files…> [options]
```

Id `video.compress` · MCP `video_compress` · Output: files · Timeout 240 min

Also found by: reduce size, smaller, shrink, target size, bitrate, 2-pass, email, discord

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Videos. Accepts video/\*, .mkv .mp4 .mov .webm .avi .m4v +10 more. |
| `mode` | `--mode` | choice | `quality` | One of: `quality` (By quality level), `size` (To a target file size). |
| `level` | `--level` | choice | `balanced` | One of: `light` (Light (best quality)), `balanced`, `strong` (Strong (smallest)). Only used when `mode` is `quality`. |
| `target_mb` | `--target-mb` | number 0.1–100000 | `25` | Target size (MB). Only used when `mode` is `size`. |
| `max_resolution` | `--max-resolution` | choice | `keep` | Cap the shorter side of the video. One of: `keep`, `2160` (4K (2160p)), `1440` (1440p), `1080` (1080p), `720` (720p), `480` (480p), `360` (360p). |
| `codec` | `--codec` | choice | `h264` | One of: `h264` (H.264 (MP4, most compatible)), `h265` (H.265 (MP4, smaller)), `av1` (AV1 (MP4, smallest, slow)), `vp9` (VP9 (WebM)). |
| `audio_kbps` | `--audio-kbps` | integer 16–320 | `128` | Audio bitrate (kbit/s). *Advanced.* |
| `speed` | `--speed` | choice | `medium` | One of: `fast`, `medium`, `slow` (Slow (smaller)). *Advanced.* |
| `hardware` | `--hardware` | choice | `none` | Use a hardware encoder when present (falls back to software). One of: `none` (Software only), `auto` (Auto (use GPU if available)), `nvenc` (NVIDIA NVENC), `qsv` (Intel Quick Sync), `vaapi` (VA-API), `videotoolbox` (Apple VideoToolbox), `amf` (AMD AMF). *Advanced.* |

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-external">external engine</span><span>FFmpeg</span><span>FFprobe</span><span>progress</span></div>

Scale videos to a preset (4K…240p), custom size or percentage, keeping aspect ratio with fit, fill (crop) or pad modes.

```sh
dogubako video resize <files…> [options]
```

Id `video.resize` · MCP `video_resize` · Output: files · Timeout 240 min

Also found by: scale, resolution, 1080p, 720p, downscale, upscale, dimensions, letterbox

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Videos. Accepts video/\*, .mkv .mp4 .mov .webm .avi .m4v +10 more. |
| `size` | `--size` | choice | `720` | Presets set the shorter side of the video. One of: `2160` (4K (2160p)), `1440` (1440p), `1080` (1080p), `720` (720p), `480` (480p), `360` (360p), `240` (240p), `custom` (Custom width/height), `percent` (Percentage). |
| `width` | `--width` | integer 16–8192 |  | Leave empty to derive from height. Only used when `size` is `custom`. |
| `height` | `--height` | integer 16–8192 |  | Leave empty to derive from width. Only used when `size` is `custom`. |
| `percent` | `--percent` | number 1–400 | `50` | Only used when `size` is `percent`. |
| `fit` | `--fit` | choice | `fit` | One of: `fit` (Fit (keep aspect)), `fill` (Fill (crop to exact size)), `pad` (Pad (letterbox to exact size)), `stretch`. Only used when `size` is `custom`. |
| `pad_color` | `--pad-color` | color | `#000000` | Only used when `fit` is `pad`. *Advanced.* |
| `upscale` | `--upscale` | boolean | `false` | Allow making videos larger than the source. *Advanced.* |
| `quality` | `--quality` | choice | `medium` | Encoding quality used when the video must be re-encoded. One of: `high` (High (larger file)), `medium` (Balanced), `low` (Low (smaller file)). *Advanced.* |
